deployment: shared dev deployment (namespace impossible — see collision note)

interrupt.resumeMechanism: none — the official path has no resumable protocol; the upload URL is single-shot POST

share.ttlMechanism: getUrl() returns a long-lived unguessable URL; no TTL parameter, no per-issuance authorization
share.revocation: delete the file (or gate a custom HTTP action); no signed-URL expiry surface

deletion.referenceTracking: none: the clips row held a storageId; deleting the file leaves dangling ids unless the app cleans up (documented app responsibility)

geoPrivacy.note: unchanged ⇒ location metadata served verbatim; no server-side media surface

limits.docs: Convex file storage: no documented resumable protocol; upload URL is single-shot; file size limits per plan

cleanup.note: Convex deploy is deployment-global: see the collision finding in the diary
